svg.title: Research in motion — mathematical models, molecular simulations and connected systems
svg.desc: A decorative, twelve-second animated scientific illustration: a changing mathematical mesh, a bonded molecular assembly, cellular membranes and a communicating network. Pastel blue, turquoise, mint, lavender, rose and peach on a pearl-blue background. These are abstract illustrations, not measured research data. Reduced-motion preferences show a still scene.
